name: Parrot
text: Hello! I am a PARROT! (Press V to continue)

name: Parrot
text: Did you see those pesky balloons out there?

name: Parrot
text: That's for me to know and for you to find out 😂

name: Parrot
text: I tried popping one of these balloons with my razor sharp beak...

name: Parrot
text: ...and there were COINS™ inside of it!

name: Parrot
text: Yeah its super cool. I'll tell you what.

name: Parrot
text: If you get bring me 500 coins™...

name: Parrot
text: ...I will give you something that will CHANGE YOUR LIFE™.
